achievements.name: A Druid's Sidekick
achievements.desc: Unlock the listed upgrades from Sydekix's Shop.
achievements.tip: Unlock the upgrades listed below from Sydekix's Shop of Balance at the Garden of Kharid. This requires a total of 193,950 Crux Eqal favour.

achievements.name: A Song of Ice and Ire II
achievements.page: A Song of Ice and Ire II
achievements.desc: Defeat the Arch-Glacor at 100% enrage.
achievements.tip: Defeat the Arch-Glacor at 100% enrage.

achievements.name: Agile from Head to Toe
achievements.desc: Unlock the agile top and leg rewards from advanced Agility courses.
achievements.tip: Get the agile top and legs. They each require 250 completed laps of the advanced Barbarian Outpost and Gnome Stronghold Agility courses, respectively. An Agile outfit enhancer can be used to cut the amount of laps needed in half.

achievements.name: All Your Energies
achievements.desc: Unlock the energy-gathering scrimshaw scroll from Waiko ports reward shop.
achievements.tip: Unlock the energy-gathering scrimshaw scroll from the Ports Reward Shop for 5,000 chimes and 5 taijitu.

achievements.name: Bone to Pick With You
achievements.desc: Unlock the bonecrusher upgrade from Waiko reward shop.
achievements.tip: Unlock the upgrade for the bonecrusher from the waiko reward shop for 25,000 chimes and 25 taijitu.

achievements.name: Build Them All!
achievements.desc: Build all of the Treasure Trail hidey-holes. You can find a complete list of hidey-holes at the noticeboard by Zaida.
achievements.tip: Build Them All! is an achievement awarded for building all hidey-holes. Filling all hidey-holes is a separate achievement, Fill Them All!.

achievements.name: Canoe Fix It? Yes You Can!
achievements.page: Canoe Fix It? Yes You Can!
achievements.desc: Repair all the canoe stations around Havenhythe.
achievements.tip: Repair the six dilapidated canoe stations scattered across Havenhythe.

achievements.name: Champions. What Champions?
achievements.desc: Defeat all champions in the Champions' Challenge.
achievements.tip: Defeat all 15 champions after finding their respective scroll (with exceptions for the human and gnome champions who instead challenge the player directly).

achievements.name: Chompy Massacre
achievements.desc: Kill chompy birds.
achievements.tip: Kill 4,000 chompy birds. Jubbly birds will also count towards the achievement, with each kill counting as one chompy bird (plucking is not required). The progress earned from killing either bird can be doubled by the use of a chompy bird enhancer.

achievements.name: Collectors Assemble
achievements.desc: Complete all collections for archaeological collectors.
achievements.tip: Complete all Archaeology collections.

achievements.name: Completionist Cape
achievements.desc: Complete all these to be able to obtain the completionist cape.

links.name: Almost as Perky as a Prawn
Bean There, Done That, Got the Postcard
I've Got a Little List (of Miniquests)
It Should Have Been Called Aetherium
It Should Have Been Called Ancestral
It Should Have Been Called Chinskin
It Still Should Have Been Called Aetherium

achievements.tip: Complete all the following achievements, enabling the player to obtain the completionist cape. The completionist cape can still be claimed if the only remaining (indirect) achievements have an active grace period.

achievements.name: Conquered Everyone's Heart
achievements.desc: Reach maximum reputation with all Heart of Gielinor factions.
achievements.tip: Reach maximum reputation with all Heart of Gielinor factions. It requires the following achievements.

achievements.name: Cracking
achievements.desc: Crack open each visible part of the millipede colossus.
achievements.tip: Mine the first layer of each essence vein, essence deposit, and large essence deposit in the Exalted Quarry, requiring a Mining level of 65, 85, and 105 respectively. By mining the first layer of these essence deposits, the player gains access to the essence lumps, chunks, and slabs underneath which can be further processed into pure essence or exalted essence.

achievements.name: Death Effect
achievements.desc: Unlock all permanent effects from Death's Store.
achievements.tip: Unlock all listed permanent effects from Death's Store.

achievements.name: Don't Crush My Memories
achievements.desc: Unlock the memory-crushing scrimshaw scroll from the Waiko ports reward shop.
achievements.tip: Unlock the memory-crushing scrimshaw from the Ports Reward Shop for 5,000 chimes and 5 taijitu.

achievements.name: Draught Includer
achievements.desc: Discover all invention blueprints.
achievements.tip: Draught Includer is an achievement awarded for discovering all 159 invention blueprints.

achievements.name: Dream Team
achievements.desc: Start a research contract with a full team of consultants.
achievements.tip: Have a full research team consisting of five consultants and send that team off on a research contract.

achievements.name: E-I-E-DI-NO
achievements.desc: Complete the Ranch Out of Time breeding log.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the animal breeding logs at the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm by completing the achievements listed below.

achievements.name: E-I-E-I-O
achievements.desc: Complete the breeding log.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the animal breeding logs at Manor Farm by completing the achievements listed below.

achievements.name: Eastern Explorer
achievements.desc: Explore the Eastern Lands as far as the Shield from your port. Distance travelled:

oneOf.text: 90 Agility or 90 Construction or 90 Cooking or 90 Divination or 90 Dungeoneering or 90 Fishing or 90 Herblore or 90 Hunter or 90 Prayer or 90 Runecrafting or 90 Slayer or 90 Thieving

achievements.tip: Explore all regions of the Wushanko Isles including the final region, the Shield, in player-owned port.

achievements.name: Elder Wisdom
achievements.desc: Earn the Wisdom of Anima fletching perk for all the Elder God arrow types.
achievements.tip: Unlock all the Wisdom of Anima perks for Elder God arrows (a Fletching benefit) after upgrading the Ranger's Workroom at Fort Forinthry to Tier 3.

achievements.name: Ferocious Upgrade
achievements.desc: Unlock the upgrade to the ferocious ring so it can be used in Morvran's arena.
achievements.tip: Unlock the upgrade for ferocious ring to the slayer helmet from Morvran. Although this upgrade appears in the shop for any Slayer Master, it can only actually be purchased from Morvran after completing the Plague's End quest.

achievements.name: Finish Him!
achievements.desc: Personally defeat Vorago with the Maul of Omens.
achievements.tip: Obtain the maul of omens during the fight with Vorago by collecting all 3 parts during phases 1, 2, and 4 respectively and using it to finish off Vorago. It is not required to be the person to collect all of the maul pieces, only to use it in phase 5.

achievements.name: Finished unpacking!
achievements.desc: Access the fourth room of the player-owned slayer dungeon.
achievements.tip: Access the fourth room in the Sunken Pyramid after purchasing it for 3,000 slayer points from the Slayer Rewards shop.

achievements.name: Get Tooled Up
achievements.desc: Fill up your tool belt.

links.name: A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift

achievements.tip: Fill up their tool belt.

achievements.name: Globetrotter
achievements.desc: Purchase the full Globetrotter outfit.
achievements.tip: Purchase the full globetrotter outfit from the Treasure Trails Reward Shop.

achievements.name: God of the Grind
achievements.desc: Fully repair the statue of Het.
achievements.tip: Fully repair the statue of Het in the centre of Het's Oasis. This requires 200 pieces of Het. The repair consists of four steps, each requiring 50 pieces to complete. The rate and quantity at which pieces of Het drop is affected by luck modifiers, with 1–2 pieces being found at a time.

achievements.name: Granny's Favourite Farmer
achievements.desc: Gain max reputation with the Farming Guild.
achievements.tip: Granny's Favourite Farmer is an achievement awarded for obtaining maximum reputation with the Farming Guild which is 2,500,000.

achievements.name: Hard as Daemons
achievements.desc: Earn the right to wear the title 'of Daemonheim'.
achievements.tip: Claim the [Name] of Daemonheim title. This requires the player to complete every Dungeoneering floor on hard mode.

achievements.name: Honourary Imcando
achievements.desc: Craft all of Kili's equipment upgrades.
achievements.tip: Fully upgrade each piece of deathwarden robe armour, deathdealer robe armour, and Death Skull equipment at least once by completing the following achievements.

achievements.name: Jack of the Circus
achievements.desc: Obtain all circus clothing from Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza.
achievements.tip: Claim all of the circus equipment from Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza.

achievements.name: Jail break
achievements.desc: Free each of the baby dinosaurs from the jail cells within the Rex Matriarch lair.
achievements.tip: Use jail cell keys to free each of the baby dinosaurs within the Rex Matriarchs lair. The Osseous Rex quest must be partially done to complete this achievement.

achievements.name: Jurassic Perk
achievements.desc: Discover all the totem pieces on Anachronia.
achievements.tip: Discover all the totem pieces on Anachronia. The Remototem pieces are not required to complete this achievement.

achievements.name: Kal'gerion Commander
achievements.desc: Unlock the Kal'gerion battle commendation titles.
achievements.tip: Unlock all the titles obtainable from the Kal'gerion battle commendations which are dropped by Kal'gerion demons.

achievements.name: Like Farming Fish in a Pool - Giant Crayfish
achievements.page: Like Farming Fish in a Pool - Giant Crayfish
achievements.desc: Catch 250 giant crayfish at the Wendlewick fish farm.
achievements.tip: Catch 250 giant crayfish at the Wendlewick fish farm.

achievements.name: Like Farming Fish in a Pool - Shark
achievements.page: Like Farming Fish in a Pool - Shark
achievements.desc: Catch 250 sharks at the Wendlewick fish farm.
achievements.tip: Catch 250 sharks at the Wendlewick fish farm.

achievements.name: Like Farming Fish in a Pool - Swordfish
achievements.page: Like Farming Fish in a Pool - Swordfish
achievements.desc: Catch 250 swordfish at the Wendlewick fish farm.
achievements.tip: Catch 250 swordfish at the Wendlewick fish farm.

achievements.name: Mama-Rummer-Totummer
achievements.desc: Fletch one of each Linbog totem.
achievements.tip: Fletch one of each Linbog totem. The highest level totem requires petrified logs requiring a Woodcutting level of 105 to chop and a Fletching level of 105 to fletch the totems.

achievements.name: Maria, You Gotta See Her
achievements.desc: Complete all three additional challenges from Maria in the Broken Home quest.
achievements.tip: Complete all three challenges in the haunted house after Broken Home.

achievements.name: Master Angler
achievements.desc: Purchase the champion's tackle box from the Fish Flingers fisherman.
achievements.tip: Obtain the Champion's tackle box from Fish Flingers. This requires a total of 1,860 tokens and 500 medals if upgrading from the Professional Tackle Box or a cumulative 3,570 tokens and 500 medals if starting from scratch.

achievements.name: Master Builder
achievements.desc: Fully upgrade the base camp on Anachronia.
achievements.tip: Fully upgrade the base camp on Anachronia. It doesn't require the player to build the remote totem charging point.

achievements.name: Master Otto
achievements.desc: Complete all barbarian training with Otto, at his grotto west of Baxtorian Falls.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the Barbarian Training with Otto Godblessed.

achievements.name: Master Quest Cape
achievements.desc: Complete all these to be able to obtain the master quest cape.
achievements.tip: Master Quest Cape is an achievement encompassing many quest and post-quest achievements. Completion of it is required for players to obtain the master quest cape, unless the only remaining achievements have an active grace period.

achievements.name: Mastery - Daemonheim
achievements.desc: Fully explore the history of the Daemonheim Dig Site.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the listed achievements related to the Daemonheim Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mastery - Everlight
achievements.desc: Fully explore the history of the Everlight Dig Site.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the listed achievements related to the Everlight Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mastery - Infernal Source
achievements.desc: Fully explore the history of the Infernal Source Dig Site.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the listed achievements related to the Infernal Source Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mastery - Kharid-et
achievements.desc: Fully explore the history of the Kharid-et Dig Site.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the achievements related to the Kharid-et Dig Site listed below.

achievements.name: Mastery - Moonrise
achievements.desc: Fully explore the history of the Moonrise Dig Site.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the listed achievements related to the Moonrise Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mastery - Orthen
achievements.desc: Fully explore the history of the Orthen Dig Site.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the listed achievements related to the Orthen Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mastery - Senntisten
achievements.desc: Fully explore the history of the Senntisten Dig Site.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the listed achievements related to the Senntisten Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mastery - Stormguard Citadel
achievements.desc: Fully explore the history of the Stormguard Dig Site.

links.name: Home is Where the God is

achievements.tip: Complete all of the listed achievements related to the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mastery - Warforge
achievements.desc: Fully explore the history of the Warforge Dig Site.
achievements.tip: Complete all of the listed achievements related to the Warforge Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mazcab Teleport
achievements.desc: Unlock the Mazcab Teleport spell.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Mazcab Teleport spell by reading a Mazcab teleport or ability codex.

achievements.name: Memorialised More Than Once
achievements.desc: Prestige the Memorial to Guthix three times.
achievements.tip: Complete the Memorial to Guthix Distractions and Diversion three times in order to unlock the ability to have five passive abilities active at once.

achievements.name: Mitts and Waders - Death Lotus
achievements.desc: Unlock the death lotus gloves and boots scrolls from the Waiko reward shop.
achievements.tip: Buy the Death Lotus boots and Death Lotus gloves scrolls from the Ports Reward Shop, costing 2,500 chimes and 3 taijitu each.

achievements.name: Mitts and Waders - Seasinger
achievements.desc: Unlock the seasinger gloves and boots scrolls from the Waiko reward shop.
achievements.tip: Buy seasinger boots scroll and seasinger gloves scroll from the Ports Reward Shop, both costing 2,500 chimes and 3 taijitu each.

achievements.name: Mitts and Waders - Tetsu
achievements.desc: Unlock the tetsu gloves and boots scrolls from the Waiko reward shop.
achievements.tip: Buy the Superior tetsu kogake and Superior tetsu kote scrolls from the Ports Reward Shop, both costing 2,500 chimes and 3 taijitu each.

achievements.name: My Goebie Homies
achievements.desc: Obtain maximum reputation with the goebies on Mazcab.
achievements.tip: Reach maximum of 5,000 reputation with the goebies on Mazcab.

achievements.name: Nomad's Mirage
achievements.desc: Defeat the memory of Nomad and loot one of his bounty chests.
achievements.tip: Defeat the Memory of Nomad and loot the chest thereafter.

achievements.name: On a Rune High
achievements.desc: Unlock the highest rune shop from Ali Morrisane, by completing the 'Rogue Trader' miniquest.
achievements.tip: Unlock the highest rune shop from Ali Morrisane, only doable after The Feud and partial completion of the Ali the Trader achievement.

achievements.name: One Ten-Thousandth of a Milly
achievements.desc: Hand in 100 millipede legs to Azur.
achievements.tip: Hand in 100 colossal legs to Azur, which can be obtained by mining essence veins, essence deposits, and large essence deposits in the Exalted Quarry. The legs can be obtained while mining the outside and inside layers of the essence deposits, so spending as much time as possible on the outer layer by never refreshing the stamina will allow the most uninterrupted mining time. The inner layer of the deposits gives items that fill the inventory and stop mining. If desired, the essence slabs received can be dropped or processed.

achievements.name: Out of this World
achievements.desc: Unlock everything in the Shooting Star Reward Shop.
achievements.tip: Unlock every upgrade, title, and pet available from the Shooting Star Reward Shop. This requires 28,000 stardust.

achievements.name: Penguin Adoption Agency
achievements.desc: Adopt Sheldon the penguin by tracking penguin spies around the world.
achievements.tip: Adopt Sheldon the Penguin by spying on 80 penguin spies (Penguin Hide and Seek) around the world.

achievements.name: Perky Like a Prawn
achievements.desc: Gain all possible Prawn Perk Points for your Aquarium.

links.name: Almost as Perky as a Prawn

achievements.tip: Earn all prawn perks points from the Prawnbroker in the aquarium in the player-owned house. This can be done by collecting golden fish eggs and gaining 1, 20, 100, and 200 prawn balls and prawn crackers. This is three more Prawn Perk points than are required to earn all the Prawn Perks and complete the Almost as Perky as a Prawn achievement.

achievements.name: Rank: Master Finix
achievements.desc: Obtain rank 1 esteem from Wizard Finix.
achievements.tip: Obtain the rank 1 esteem from Wizard Finix in Runespan. This will cost a total of 211,860 runespan points.

achievements.name: Raptor's Revenge
achievements.desc: Complete the Ungael combat activity on hard mode.
achievements.tip: Complete the hard mode encounter of the Ungael combat activity. Completing this achievement is a requirement for the Trimmed Completionist Cape achievement.

achievements.name: Reaper Crew
achievements.desc: Defeat listed bosses at least once.
achievements.tip: Defeat every listed boss at least once.

achievements.name: Relic-weary
achievements.desc: Unlock all relic powers at the monolith.
achievements.tip: Unlock all of the relic powers.

achievements.name: Remotely Possible
achievements.desc: Build the Remote Totem Access Point in the base camp on Anachronia.
achievements.tip: Build the remote totem access point in the Anachronia base camp.

achievements.name: Reputation - Class Crown
achievements.desc: Earn tier 10 reputation with the imperial faction in Menaphos.
other: Tier 10 reputation in the Imperial district
achievements.tip: Gain tier 10 reputation in the Imperial district.

achievements.name: Reputation - Lock, Stock and Barrel
achievements.desc: Earn tier 10 reputation with the merchant faction in Menaphos.
other: Tier 10 reputation in the Merchant district
achievements.tip: Get tier 10 reputation in the merchant district in Menaphos.

achievements.name: Reputation - Seagullible
achievements.desc: Earn tier 10 reputation with the ports faction in Menaphos.
other: Tier 10 reputation in the Ports district
achievements.tip: Get tier 10 reputation in the ports district in Menaphos.

achievements.name: Reputation - To the Bone
achievements.desc: Earn tier 10 reputation with the worker faction in Menaphos.
other: Tier 10 reputation in the Worker district
achievements.tip: Get tier 10 reputation in the worker district in Menaphos.

achievements.name: Salty
achievements.desc: Fully explore what the Arc has to offer, and earn the right to claim the 'Salty' title.
achievements.tip: Complete most content in the Arc.

achievements.name: Sandy
achievements.desc: Complete various achievements within Menaphos... and then some more to earn the right to claim the 'Sandy' title.
achievements.tip: Unlock all Menaphos rewards.

achievements.name: Scrolling in the Deep
achievements.desc: Find every scroll piece in Player Owned Ports.

oneOf.text: 90 Agility or 90 Construction or 90 Cooking or 90 Divination or 90 Dungeoneering or 90 Fishing or 90 Herblore or 90 Hunter or 90 Prayer or 90 Runecrafting or 90 Slayer or 90 Thieving

achievements.tip: Find all scroll pieces in their player-owned port.

achievements.name: Scrolling with Power
achievements.desc: Unlock the Dungeoneering scroll traits.
achievements.tip: Unlock all Dungeoneering scroll traits, except for the scroll of gathering.

achievements.name: Shadows Below
achievements.desc: Survive the shadow beneath the barrows.
achievements.tip: Defeat the Barrows: Rise of the Six, loot the chest, and successfully escape the tunnel while it is collapsing.

achievements.name: Sort of Crystally
achievements.desc: Obtain the 'Dark Lord' title by unlocking a selection of titles from Prifddinas.
achievements.tip: Sort of Crystally is an achievement awarded for obtaining a number of titles for activities in Prifddinas. The Dark Lord [Name] title is awarded for completing this achievement.

achievements.name: Special Slayer Delivery
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to craft the listed Slayer items.
achievements.tip: Buy the below learn abilities from the Slayer Rewards shop costing a total of 1,900 Slayer points.

achievements.name: Stone's Throw Away
achievements.desc: Complete the Dahmaroc statue in your player-owned house.
achievements.tip: Collect all 30 replica statue pieces to use on the Dahmaroc statue in the player's player-owned house.

achievements.name: Telos If You're Angry II
achievements.desc: Defeat Telos at 100% enrage.
achievements.tip: Defeat Telos, the Warden at 100% enrage.

achievements.name: The Golden Crocodile Hunter
achievements.desc: Unlock all Hunter upgrades from Dundee's Shop.
achievements.tip: Unlock all Hunter upgrades from the Dundee's Crocodile Upgrades shop, requiring a total of 5,000 scarabs caught at Het's Oasis (stacked scarabs also count towards this total). As the name implies, this differs from The Crocodile Hunter achievement in that unlocking the golden crocodile cosmetic upgrade is required.

achievements.name: The Prodigal Spender
achievements.desc: Purchase all permanent unlocks from Ezreal's shop at the Archaeology Guild.
achievements.tip: Purchase all permanent unlocks from Ezreal's Archaeology Guild Shop.

achievements.name: To Be a Master
achievements.desc: Fully complete the slayer codex.
other: Partial completion of Heralds of Crimson
achievements.tip: Complete the Slayer Codex, requiring all 175 slayer monster souls.

achievements.name: Um Pop
achievements.desc: Meet all of the listed inhabitants of Um.
achievements.tip: Successfully interact with certain named inhabitants of the City of Um. Although they aren't listed as requirements in the Achievement interface, Nomad's Elegy and the various quests in the First Necromancer and City of Um quest series are required.

achievements.name: War. What Is It Good For?
achievements.page: War. What Is It Good For?
achievements.desc: Buy all unlocks and upgrades from War's store.
achievements.tip: Complete the two other achievements associated with War's Retreat. This requires at least 2,000 boss kills, 7,000 Marks of War, and 1,000 each of oak, willow, maple, yew, magic, elder, and eternal magic logs, valued at 18,760,000 coins at the Grand Exchange.

achievements.name: Who Will Be Her Lover?
achievements.desc: Complete the replica statue of Rhiannon in the Max Guild garden.
achievements.tip: Complete the Statue of Rhiannon statue 32 times to rebuild its twin fully in the Max Guild garden.

achievements.name: Work on Your Artisan II
achievements.desc: Unlock all rewards from the Artisans' Workshop (including outfits and excluding auras).
achievements.tip: Unlock all of the rewards listed below from the Artisans' Workshop. Completion of Work on Your Artisan isn't required although this is likely a bug as the achievement is listed as a requirement.
